subject: Demo recap and gated trial plan — MetroForma evaluation
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Angela Morris <angela.m@metroforma.com>, Darren Cho <darren.cho@metroforma.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap and gated trial plan — MetroForma evaluation

Hi Angela / Darren,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid context about where MetroForma is trying to get with document summarization and search. Quick recap + a proposed, gated trial structure so we can align on success criteria and owners.

TL;DR (attached: gated trial plan + success checklist)
- 4-week gated trial with two gates (week 2: integration + smoke tests; week 4: quality & latency SLOs)
- Success metrics: 1) extractive QA F1 >= 0.78 on your benchmark set, 2) median latency < 350ms for 2-4 token responses on the staging load profile, 3) false-positive rate on PII redaction < 0.5%
- Data & access: S3 read-only for a 2000 doc sample + a synthetic query set (security notes below)
- Owners: MetroForma data (Angela / Darren), Redwood implementation (Marcus), Redwood CS (Monica), Performance lead (Ben)

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (this week): sign off on trial charter + NDA addendum for S3 access
- Week 1: infra provisioning, sample ingestion, integration smoke tests
- Week 2: gate 1 (integration pass) — quick sync to review ingest logs and latency baseline
- Week 3: focused tuning (quantization/profile suggestions) and rerun evals
- Week 4: gate 2 (quality + SLO pass) and exec readout; decision to extend or expand

Open questions for MetroForma (please confirm in reply):
1) Can you provision a read-only S3 bucket or grant temporary signed URLs for the 2k-document sample?
2) Who on your side will own the benchmark query set (mapping of 500 queries to documents)?
3) Any compliance constraints beyond SOC2 we should be aware of for a staging run?

Attachments: metroforma_gated_trial_plan_v1.pdf, success_criteria_checklist.xlsx

Next steps:
- If you agree, I’ll update the trial charter and send a short DocuSign for the addendum. Monica will reach out with kickoff availability for next week.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Angela Morris <angela.m@metroforma.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Darren Cho <darren.cho@metroforma.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Demo recap and gated trial plan — MetroForma evaluation

Thanks Marcus — helpful summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- We can provide a read-only S3 bucket, but procurement needs the addendum and a cost estimate for the reserved trial window.
- The benchmark owner will be our ML engineer Priya Shah (cc'd on procurement thread separately) — she'll own query mapping and labeling.
- Compliance: we will need a short list of required evidence (SOC2 + data flow diagram + any encryption-at-rest details) — our security reviewer is Darren (cc).

Could you:
- Share the exact list of artifacts you need for security review (I want to make sure we don't miss anything),
- Add a rough estimate of expected egress costs and any temporary infra we spin up (ballpark is fine).

If we can get the addendum + artifact list by EOD Friday we can aim for provisioning the bucket next Wednesday.

Best,
Angela

--
Angela Morris
Head of Data Platform, MetroForma
angela.m@metroforma.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Angela Morris <angela.m@metroforma.com>, Darren Cho <darren.cho@metroforma.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap and gated trial plan — MetroForma evaluation

Angela — thanks. Quick answers and an update from our side:

1) Security artifacts: I attached a concise pack we typically hand to procurement/security reviewers — it includes SOC2 summary, a one-page data flow diagram, our encryption-at-rest key-handling notes (KMS integrations), and a short checklist for temporary-bucket access. (Attachment referenced inline.)
2) Egress / infra estimate: for a 2k doc ingest and evaluation (staging only) expect < $300 in egress and storage. If we run high-concurrency load tests that may add up (I’ll call out that separately).
3) Addendum: I’ve created a one-page addendum and a DocuSign link — I’ll send the DocuSign once you confirm the contact for signature.

Monica — can you own the internal kickoff scheduling and the onboarding steps (file mappings, tokenization checks, and perf baseline run)?

Ben — please plan for a perf smoke run (cold-cache) after ingestion and a configured load profile that matches MetroForma’s 95th percentile query mix.

Onboarding checklist (short)
- DocuSign addendum signed (procurement)
- S3 read-only creds or signed URLs provisioned
- Sample mapping file (CSV) and query set (JSON) delivered by MetroForma
- Redwood ingestion job run + smoke perf run
- Gate 1 sync scheduled

Attachment: redwood_security_pack_for_trials_v1.pdf

I’ll update the trial plan doc and re-share the DocuSign when procurement contact confirmed.

Best,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks — Monica
